description: This file defines the interface for a JPEG encoder class and related constants, enums, and structures used for JPEG encoding in an Android environment, specifically for Samsung devices. It includes API declarations, memory size calculations, and IOCTL command definitions.

classes.name: JpegEncoder
classes.description: A class providing methods to encode JPEG images, manage buffers, and handle EXIF data.

methods.name: openHardware
methods.description: Opens hardware resources for JPEG encoding.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration parameters for JPEG encoding.

methods.name: getInBuf
methods.description: Returns input buffer for image data.

methods.name: getOutBuf
methods.description: Returns output buffer for encoded JPEG data.

methods.name: getThumbInBuf
methods.description: Returns input buffer for thumbnail image.

methods.name: getThumbOutBuf
methods.description: Returns output buffer for thumbnail JPEG.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Performs JPEG encoding with optional EXIF data.

methods.name: makeExif
methods.description: Creates EXIF data for JPEG images.

methods.name: checkMcu
methods.description: Checks MCU (Minimum Coded Unit) parameters for encoding.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Pads image buffers to meet encoding requirements.

methods.name: writeExifIfd
methods.description: Writes EXIF IFD entries into buffer.
